visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page brand banner: full-width photo background, large uppercase headline, intro copy, CTA button and a product cutout image overlapping the bottom edge
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text block top-left over background photo; product image centered below the text, extending past the block's bottom edge

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading (h1), intro paragraph, CTA link, optional product image (picture). The product image may also be authored as its own picture-only cell

usage: Homepage or landing page top hero with a featured product cutout.
reuseGuidance: Use when the hero pairs a photo background with a product image that overlaps the following section. For a plain photo hero use hero; for an offset text panel with logo and badge use hero-promo.
